cases.sentence: И мой Бог положил мне на сердце собрать знать, приближенных и ___ для переписи по родословиям.
cases.explain: «простой народ» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:

cases.explain: «Храмовые служители» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai: one hundred thirty-eight.

cases.explain: «храмовых слуг» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon’s servants were three hundred ninety-two.

cases.sentence: Наместник приказал им не есть от ___, пока не появится священник, который сможет воспользоваться Уримом и Туммимом .
cases.explain: «великой святыни» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The governor told that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.

cases.sentence: Весь ___ дал 20 000 драхм золота, 2000 мин серебра и 67 священнических одеяний.
cases.explain: «остальной народ» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, plus two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.

cases.sentence: Священники, левиты, служащие у ворот, певцы, часть народа, ___ и весь Израиль поселились в своих городах .
cases.explain: «храмовые слуги» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel, lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.
